Title: Public preview: Azure Percept DK November (2111) software update is available

Body.Content:
Over the Air (OTA) package and USB cable update image are available in public preview. Review the update strategy guidance before choosing between the two update methods. Updates are highly recommended in order to keep your device up to date with latest fixes and features.

Learn more in the release notes.
